task.title: Configuring a station for EDE
task.shortdesc: Before you can use the EDE configuration utility to discover devices and points offline, the EDE tool must be enabled in the station. Both the controller and Supervisor stations require this configuration.

taskbody.prereq: The Supervisor or controller station is running and connected using .

step.stepresult: Bacnet EDE appears as a node under the My Tools folder in the station. This component has a single property, Store Time, which defaults to 30 minutes.

step.cmd: If needed, adjust the time and click Save.
